final: WITH acct AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS a FROM trans t JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ac.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(a) AS r FROM acct GROUP BY region), ov AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS o FROM reg), kept AS (SELECT reg.region AS region, reg.r AS r, reg.r - ov.o AS diff FROM reg JOIN ov ON ov.o IS NOT NULL WHERE reg.r > ov.o), fin AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS f FROM kept) SELECT kept.region, kept.r, kept.diff, kept.r / fin.f AS ratio FROM kept JOIN fin ON fin.f IS NOT NULL
